scope: Supervised registry discovery and synthetic/benign-fixture suite invocations. Coordinator editing, repository preflight and administrative record verification are separate operations.

metadata_after_test_change.reason: Report actual completed suite; README is not consumed by the checker or production functions. All four code files and protocol binding remain byte-identical to the tested copy.

limitations: No independent review, source acceptance, live group-memory guard or measurement admission.

Previous producer/reviewer custody gaps remain unavailable and are not repaired by this package.
Created-handle/name rechecks are not atomic against a privileged concurrent namespace mutator.
